        d = {}
        for r in rows:

                d[v] = d.get(v, 0) + 1
        return max(d, key=d.get)

    hs = [r for r in range(1, h - 1) if len(set(g[r])) == 1]
    if hs:
        b = hs[0]
        spans = [(0, b), (b + 1, h)]
        info = []
        for lo, hi in spans:
            bg = mode(range(lo, hi), range(w))
            cells = [(r, c, g[r][c]) for r in range(lo, hi) for c in range(w)
                     if g[r][c] != bg]
            dist = min((min(r - lo, hi - 1 - r) for r, c, v in cells), default=999)
            info.append((bg, cells, dist))
        src = 0 if info[0][2] < info[1][2] else 1
        dst = 1 - src
        lo, hi = spans[src]
        bg = info[src][0]
        tlo, thi = spans[dst]
        near = thi - 1 if dst == 0 else tlo
        far = tlo if dst == 0 else thi - 1
        original = [row[:] for row in grid]
        for r, c, v in info[src][1]:
            ref = original[near][c]
            g[near if ref == v else far][c] = v
        for r in range(lo, hi):
            for c in range(w):
                if (r == near or r == far) and any(rr == r and cc == c for rr, cc, vv in info[src][1]):
                    continue
                if original[r][c] != bg:
                    g[r][c] = bg
    else:

        for r, c, v in info[src][1]:
